items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: and talked to Smack, and he asked me could I make the week with him

ctx.x: And we go by the theatre where they were rehearsing, and talked to Smack, and he asked me could I make the week with him, and I told him, "Sure, why not?" Smack knew me from years before, you know. I mean, I wasn't no stranger to him. So there was no big deal, I mean, about it. Nothing... So okay, I was just hired on the moment, the spot of the moment, you know, and that was it. But it was only for the week in the theatre, that's all.
Was that a difficult book? Or what kind of a setup was that?
